conditions.cache: New Chromium process and context per case; browser HTTP cache disabled. OS filesystem cache is not cleared.
conditions.execution: Sequential; two builds served by identical loopback servers with no compression, no-store headers, and all build files preloaded in memory before timing.
conditions.timing: Navigation start / captured preset click to the first observed ready canvas and non-busy status. Resource responseEnd values define transfer boundaries; these do not isolate import, validation, or PNG decoding.
conditions.limitations: Small, order-balanced same-host sample. No browser instrumentation enters application functions. CPU contention and JIT/runtime variation may hide or exaggerate gains; report all runs and ranges. Startup and first-use preset results are separate; presets share the already-decoded source within that case.
